decisive_items: right orbital and medial cheek headache radiating to the right lateral jaw, ear, and down the right suboccipital region
This treatment also failed to resolve her symptoms
Brain magnetic resonance imaging was unremarkable
response.rationale: Continuous unilateral headache with orbital/cheek radiation to jaw, ear, and suboccipital regions, refractory to triptans, steroids, and SPG block, with normal MRI, is most consistent with hemicrania continua rather than episodic cluster/TAC or paroxysmal trigeminal neuralgia.

rejected.why: Lacks episodic short-lasting attacks and ipsilateral autonomic features; pain is described as persistent/refractory.
No paroxysmal electric-shock pain or trigeminal triggers; suboccipital radiation is atypical.
No autonomic symptoms are described, and the broad TAC category is less specific than hemicrania continua.
No evidence of acute medication overuse meeting diagnostic frequency thresholds.
New continuous unilateral headache refractory to migraine-specific therapy is not typical migraine.
